content: Manara Babel
Wakutuu incia itu, bhari-bharia alamu saangu pogauna tee saangu manga oni.
I wakutuuna manga miana apadhaangia lingkaana i wetana timbu, manga incia apotibhaaka saangu tana rata i Tana Sinear kasiimpomo amboore iwe sumai.

Pogauna manga incia samia tee mosagaanana, "Mai takarajaa bhatu bata tee tatunua sampe amakaa." Bhatu bata sumai manga incia apakea mboomo kabholosina bhatu, sainamo mina tere mboomo kabholosina tana reo.
Pogauna manga incia uka, "Mai tabhangu saangu kota tee saangu manara o lolona akawea laiana. Mai tapeelo saro to karota, mamudhaakana ingkita inda tapogaa-gaa i saangua alamu.
Kasiimpo aumbamo KAWASANA OPU to akamata kota tee manara ibhanguna maanusia sumai.

KAWASANA OPU afirimanimo, "Satotuuna, manga incia sii saangu lipu tee saangu pogauna to bhari-bharia. Sii-sii siimpo apepuungia usahana manga. Inda mangengemo uka, manga incia bheakapoia akarajaa opeapo uka peeluana manga.
Maimo Ingkita tasapo tee tapakacaua pogauna manga mamudhaakana manga inda amaʼanaia pogauna samia tee sagaanana."
Mboomo sumai KAWASANA OPU apapogaa-gaaia manga minaaka iwe sumai i saangua bhawona alamu, tee manga incia aunto apabhangu kota sumai.
Sumaimo sababuna lipu incia sumai asarongiakea Babel,
roonamo iwe sumai KAWASANA OPU apakacaua pogau saangua alamu tee minaaka iwe sumaimo KAWASANA OPU apapogaa-gaaia manga i saangua bhawona alamu.
Siwuluna Sem
Siimo siwuluna Sem. Wakutuuna Sem akoʼumuru 100 tao, alaahirimo to incia Arpakhsad, rua tao sapadhana uwena mawa.
Sem akoʼumuru 500 tao uka sapadhana incia akoanaaka Arpakhsad, tee incia dhaangiapo akoanaaka uka manga anana umane tee bhawine.
Sapadhana Arpakhsad akoʼumuru 35 tao, alaahirimo to incia Selah.
Arpakhsad akoʼumuru 403 uka sapadhana incia akoanaaka Selah tee incia dhaangiapo akoanaaka uka manga anana umane tee bhawine.
Sapadhana Selah akoʼumuru 30 tao, alaahirimo to incia Eber.
Selah adhadhi 403 tao uka sapadhana incia akoanaaka Eber, tee incia dhaangiapo uka akoanaaka manga anana umane tee bhawine.
Sapadhana Eber akoʼumuru 34 tao, alaahirimo to incia Peleg.
Eber adhadhi 430 tao uka sapadhana incia akoanaaka Peleg, tee incia dhaangiapo uka akoanaaka manga anana umane tee bhawine.
Sapadhana Peleg akoʼumuru 30 tao, alaahirimo to incia Rehu.
Peleg adhadhi 209 tao uka sapadhana incia akoanaaka Rehu tee incia dhaangia akoanaaka uka manga anana umane tee bhawine.
Sapadhana Rehu akoʼumuru 32 tao, alaahirimo to incia Serug.
Rehu adhadhi 207 tao sapadhana incia akoanaaka Serug, tee incia dhaangia akoanaaka uka manga anana umane tee bhawine.
Sapadhana Serug akoʼumuru 30 tao, alaahirimo to incia Nahor.
Serug adhadhi 200 tao uka sapadhana incia akoanaaka Nahor, tee incia dhaangiapo akoanaaka uka manga anana umane tee bhawine.
Sapadhana Nahor akoʼumuru 29 tao, alaahirimo to incia Terah.
Nahor adhadhi 119 tao uka sapadhana incia akoanaaka Terah, tee incia dhaangia akoanaaka uka manga anana umane tee bhawine.
Sapadhana Terah akoʼumuru 70 tao, alaahirimo to incia talu ana mia umane, siitumo Abram, Nahor tee Haran.
Siwuluna Terah
Siimo siwuluna Terah. Terah akoanaaka manga anana sumai: Abram, Nahor tee Haran. Kasiimpomo Haran akoanaaka anana, Lut.
Haran amate aporikana minaaka i Terah, amana, i tana laahiriana, i Ur i Babilonia.
Kasiimpomo Abram tee Nahor alosaaka bhawinena. Abram akawi tee Sarai, tee Nahor akawi tee Milka, anana bhawine Haran. Haran sumai amana Milka tee Yiska.
Sarai sumai akomba, inda akoana.

Terah alimba minaaka i kota Ur i Babilonia apobhawa-bhawa tee Abram o anana, Lut bin Haran o opuana, tee Sarai o maniana, sumai bhawinena Abram. Manga incia ahaejati alingka i Tana Kanaan, maka wakutuu akawa i Haran, manga incia uka amboore iwe sumai.
Terah akawa umuruna 205 tao, kasiimpo amatemo i kota Haran.
